I am an academic researcher working at the intersection of applied mathematics, statistics, machine learning and artificial intelligence, computational linguistics, geography, and the digital humanities. I am passionate about mathematics, the humanities and social sciences, computers, and education. What I enjoy most is designing mathematical models for all kinds of phenomena, especially in the social sciences, running numerical simulations, and building data visualizations. I created this website to share some of my work. Here you will find: - My résumé and a list of my publications (below). - Teaching materials. - Data visualizations.
